plays.description: Escapes initial pressure on third-and-13 but is taken down; Van Ness is mentioned as involved.
Runs up the middle for a first down on the final play of the first quarter.
Catches Love's pass for a first down; DB identifies a 20-yard completion deep middle.
Runs up the middle on second-and-five for another first down. Belton is named as the tackler.
Runs for a first down on second-and-seven.
Catches Love's short-right pass for a six-yard touchdown. Commentary says his motion confirmed man coverage.
Makes a sliding 16-yard catch to convert third-and-11.
Catches a 13-yard pass on third-and-nine to set up first-and-goal. Subsequent commentary references repeated one-on-one targeting without identifying the defender.
plays.coverage_scheme: one-on-one matchup mentioned; full scheme unknown

plays.description: Scores on a five-yard run around right end. Commentary describes pressing the line to draw defenders inward before going outside.
Returns the kickoff 43 yards to the GB 46.
Love's pass intended for Melton is incomplete; Green Bay will punt.
Smith initially cannot find anyone, then completes a 14-yard sideline pass to Mitchell on third-and-11.
Catches a swing pass to the 46 for a first down on third-and-five.
Spikes the ball to stop the clock.
Catches Smith's pass on the final play of the first half.
Catches a pass across midfield for a first down.
Faces intense pressure on third-and-nine; commentary names Van Ness and begins naming another defender before cutting away. Final result is not stated.
Is pressured and hit while throwing incomplete on third-and-nine.
Scrambles for a first down on third-and-four.
Takes a toss across midfield for 16 yards before being forced out.
Gains 16 yards and a first down. The following commentary contrasts this touch with a subsequent catch, indicating a run, but the exchange is unspecified.
Catches a pass over the middle for nine yards.
Catches a pass from the 19 and is taken down near the 11. A personal foul follows; the captioned endpoint is garbled.
Catches a five-yard touchdown pass as Smith faces an impending hit. DB yardage overrides the caption's preceding reference to the six.
Is targeted unsuccessfully on third-and-three. Commentary identifies linebacker Davis underneath and Cisco high.
plays.coverage_scheme: Davis underneath with Cisco high; full scheme unknown

plays.description: Turns a short-right reception into a 43-yard gain on third-and-12, making multiple moves before Nixon tackles him.
Pulls the ball down and scrambles from the 40 to the 33.
Is sacked after the Jets barely get the snap away.
Gains two yards running left tackle, then fumbles. DB credits Enagbare with the forced fumble and H. Phillips with the Jets recovery at the GB 18.
Catches Smith's swing pass on third-and-nine but finishes short of the first down.
Makes a 32-yard field goal to extend the Jets' lead to 17-7.
Catches an 18-yard pass to the Jets 47 for a first down.
Catches another 18-yard pass, reaching the Jets seven on second-and-ten.
Catches a three-yard touchdown on an inside slant. Commentary says Love waits for the safety to move before throwing.
Makes a catch; the captions cut off before specifying the gain or result.
Catches Smith's pass; the final result is cut off. Pre-snap commentary describes Evan Williams showing blitz and backing out.
plays.coverage_scheme: Evan Williams shows blitz and drops out; full scheme unknown

plays.description: Returns a punt 63 yards to the Jets 19, setting up the tying field-goal possession.
Love rolls right and targets Watson from the Jets 16; Thomas knocks the pass away.
Makes a 34-yard field goal to tie the game at 17.
Makes a catch with two flags thrown. Subsequent commentary mentions interference involving Mitchell, but the penalty disposition is unavailable.
Catches a second-and-ten pass and is tackled two yards short of the first down.
Is stuffed on a late short-yardage attempt. Commentary credits Green Bay with stops on both third and fourth down, but only one attempt is individually narrated.
Is taken down. Commentary mentions two safeties and Cisco in the end zone before the snap; the tackler's name is cut off.
plays.coverage_scheme: two safeties mentioned; full scheme unknown

plays.description: Catches a short pass on third-and-30 in overtime and is tackled at the 22 after starting from the 10; the Jets will punt.
Catches a swing pass for a first down inside the Jets 40 and makes two defenders miss. Jarvis Brownlee's late hit adds 15 penalty yards. The same play is repeated at 11:09.
Love lofts a pass toward Golden, who is knocked out of bounds by Cisco. The captions do not explicitly establish a completed catch.
Makes the winning 26-yard field goal in overtime for a 20-17 final.

offense_strengths: The opening touchdown drive features multiple rushing first downs and Watson's 20-yard reception.
Lloyd's motion identifies man coverage before his six-yard receiving touchdown.
Two 18-yard Golden catches help drive the fourth-quarter touchdown response; Watson scores on a slant after Love waits for safety movement.
Brooks converts an overtime swing pass while making two defenders miss.
Special teams support: Moore supplies 43-yard kickoff and 63-yard punt returns; Smack makes the tying and winning field goals.
defense_weaknesses: Allows several narrated third-down conversions, including Wilson for 16 yards, Mitchell for 13 and 14, and Hall for 43 on third-and-12.
Allows consecutive 16-yard gains to Hall and Isaiah Williams during the Jets' third-quarter touchdown drive.
Allows Allen's five-yard rushing touchdown and Wilson's five-yard receiving touchdown.

offense_strengths: Smith repeatedly converts third downs through Wilson and Mitchell and adds a third-and-four scramble conversion.
Hall supplies a 16-yard toss run and a 43-yard catch-and-run.
Isaiah Williams produces a 16-yard touch followed by a nine-yard reception.
Allen presses the line before going outside for his rushing touchdown; Smith delivers Wilson's touchdown while facing pressure.
defense_weaknesses: Concedes multiple rushing first downs on Green Bay's opening touchdown drive and Lloyd's touchdown against explicitly identified man coverage.
Allows two 18-yard Golden receptions during the fourth-quarter touchdown drive.
Safety movement opens space for Watson's three-yard touchdown slant.
Allows Brooks' overtime swing-pass conversion; Brownlee's late hit adds 15 yards.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed. Distinct identifiable plays are listed once, including the Brooks play repeated at 11:09. The supplied DB is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not establish that a play was absent from the full game. DB-only highlights without identifiable caption narration are omitted. Formation is unknown throughout because commentators do not explicitly identify a personnel package or formation; DB shotgun labels are not used for that field. Full coverage schemes, most routes, blocking assignments, and defenders actually beaten cannot be determined. Named DB tacklers are labeled as tacklers, not evidence they were beaten. Other named defenders who successfully defend plays are retained in descriptions. Null yardage indicates uncertainty; field-goal yardage is kick distance, and return yardage is return distance. Some gains are derived from explicitly narrated field positions or down-and-distance. Truncated names and outcomes remain unresolved where no clear DB match exists. The supplied fumble row's event label and team conflict with its narrative; the narrative establishes a GB offensive fumble recovered by NYJ.
